title: RcppOptimLib — Implementation Plan
text: R interface OptimLib, Keith O’Hara’s header-C++ library numerical optimization methods (BFGS, L-BFGS, CG, gradient descent, Newton, Nelder–Mead, differential evolution, PSO, SUMT constrained optimization, root finding), built Armadillo. package follows Rcppautodiff / RcppEnsmallen model: ship headers inst/include/ client packages can use LinkingTo: RcppOptimLib, plus small set R-callable wrappers.

title: RcppOptimLib — Implementation Plan
text: Phase 0 Phase 1 done verified: package compiles Rcpp 1.1.2 / RcppArmadillo 15.4.2.1 R 4.6.1 (Linux, gcc 13), 10 tinytest tests pass (BFGS DE C++ objectives; BFGS Nelder–Mead R-function callbacks).

title: RcppOptimLib — Implementation Plan
text: Flat header layout. OptimLib’s headers use include paths relative library root ("misc/optim_structs.hpp", "BaseMatrixOps/include/BaseMatrixOps.hpp"), sit directly inst/include/ — subdirectory. LinkingTo puts exactly one directory (<pkg>/include) compiler search path, layout works client packages without patching every include library. inst/include/RcppOptimLib.h single entry point. defines OPTIM_USE_RCPP_ARMADILLO (OptimLib includes <RcppArmadillo.h> — without flag, RcppArmadillo’s system Armadillo’s configurations mix fail link) OPTIM_DONT_USE_OPENMP, includes optim.hpp. defines live header rather src/Makevars, client packages inherit automatically. OpenMP default. OptimLib auto-enables OpenMP whenever _OPENMP defined, parallel metaheuristics (DE, PSO) evaluate objective worker threads. R’s C API single-threaded, R-function callback objective OpenMP crash session. client package uses pure C++ objectives may opt back defining RCPPOPTIMLIB_ALLOW_OPENMP including RcppOptimLib.h adding $(SHLIB_OPENMP_CXXFLAGS) Makevars. Two patches vendored code: Index-vector typedefs (marked [RcppOptimLib patch] misc/optim_options.hpp): ColVecUInt_t/RowVecUInt_t changed arma::Col<unsigned long long> arma::Col<arma::uword>. LP64 Linux arma::uword unsigned long, distinct type unsigned long long, Armadillo ≥ 12 index-vector overloads (X.rows(uvec), X(uvec)) reject upstream type. Worth offering upstream PR. Console output: std::cout/std::cerr/printf replaced mechanically (sed) Rcpp::Rcout/Rcpp::Rcerr/Rprintf across headers — CRAN forbids compiled code writing stdout/stderr, R CMD check flags symbols even print paths disabled runtime. Also pruned: BaseMatrixOps/.git, .github/ tests/ (hidden-file NOTE GNU-Makefile WARNING check). Licensing. package GPL (>= 3) (Apache-2.0 compatible GPL-3 GPL-2); bundled OptimLib BaseMatrixOps headers Apache-2.0, Copyright Keith O’Hara, listed Authors@R aut, cph. See inst/COPYRIGHTS, inst/include/optimlib-LICENSE inst/include/optimlib-NOTICE.txt.

title: RcppOptimLib — Implementation Plan
text: Goal: one optimlib() front end resembling stats::optim(): optimlib(par, fn, gr = NULL, method = c("bfgs","lbfgs","cg","gd",     "nm","de","pso"), lower = NULL, upper = NULL, control = list()) Map control onto optim::algo_settings_t (iter_max, grad_err_tol, rel_sol_change_tol, per-algorithm sub-settings de_settings.n_pop); document defaults ?optimlib gr NULL gradient-based methods, fall back OptimLib’s numerical gradient refuse clear error — decide document RNG: always route user-suppliable seed settings.rng_seed_value (OptimLib uses std::mt19937_64, R’s RNG stream); consider seeding R’s RNG via R::runif() set.seed() affects results Wrap R callback exceptions: R error inside fn must longjmp C++ frames — catch Rcpp::Function semantics return proper error (add test fn = stop("boom") fails cleanly) Return classed object (optimlib_result) print() method: par, value, iterations, success, method, settings used

title: Introduction to RcppOptimLib
text: demonstration wrappers accept plain R functions. BFGS Rosenbrock function, analytic gradient: Derivative-free Nelder–Mead needs gradient: Every objective evaluation crosses R/C++ boundary, performance-critical work write objective C++ ().
code: rosenbrock    <- function(x) 100 * (x[2] - x[1]^2)^2 + (1 - x[1])^2 rosenbrock_gr <- function(x) c(-400 * x[1] * (x[2] - x[1]^2) - 2 * (1 - x[1]),                                 200 * (x[2] - x[1]^2)) optimlib_bfgs(rosenbrock, rosenbrock_gr, c(-1.2, 1)) #> $par #> [1] 1 1 #>  #> $value #> [1] 2.233623e-18 #>  #> $iterations #> [1] 31 #>  #> $success #> [1] TRUE optimlib_nm(function(x) sum((x - 3)^2), c(0, 0)) #> $par #> [1] 3 3 #>  #> $value #> [1] 2.481919e-15 #>  #> $iterations #> [1] 66 #>  #> $success #> [1] TRUE

title: Introduction to RcppOptimLib
text: Add LinkingTo: RcppOptimLib, Rcpp, RcppArmadillo package PKG_LIBS = $(LAPACK_LIBS) $(BLAS_LIBS) $(FLIBS) src/Makevars (Armadillo needs BLAS/LAPACK; link fails Windows without ), compile standalone file Rcpp::sourceCpp(), RcppArmadillo plugin adds libraries : optim_sphere_bfgs() optim_ackley_de() exports package compiled examples exactly pattern — see src/examples.cpp. Differential evolution multimodal Ackley function, box bounds reproducible seed:
code: // [[Rcpp::depends(RcppOptimLib, RcppArmadillo)]] #include <RcppOptimLib.h>  double sphere_fn(const arma::vec& x, arma::vec* grad_out, void*) {     if (grad_out) *grad_out = 2.0 * x;     return arma::dot(x, x); }  // [[Rcpp::export]] Rcpp::List minimize_sphere(arma::vec x0) {     optim::algo_settings_t settings;     bool ok = optim::bfgs(x0, sphere_fn, nullptr, settings);     return Rcpp::List::create(         Rcpp::Named("par") = Rcpp::NumericVector(x0.begin(), x0.end()),         Rcpp::Named("value") = settings.opt_fn_value,         Rcpp::Named("success") = ok); } optim_ackley_de(c(2, -2), seed = 42L) #> $par #> [1]  0.000000e+00 -2.775558e-16 #>  #> $value #> [1] 4.440892e-16 #>  #> $iterations #> [1] 1001 #>  #> $success #> [1] TRUE

title: Introduction to RcppOptimLib
text: #include <RcppOptimLib.h> sets OPTIM_USE_RCPP_ARMADILLO ; never include OptimLib’s optim.hpp directly. OpenMP disabled default R callbacks must run worker threads; see IMPLEMENTATION.md package sources opting back pure C++ objectives. OptimLib uses RNG (std::mt19937_64), set.seed() effect stochastic algorithms — pass seed explicitly.

title: An Interface to the C++ Numerical Optimization Library OptimLib
text: R interface OptimLib, Keith O’Hara’s header-C++ library numerical optimization methods nonlinear functions — BFGS, L-BFGS, conjugate gradient, gradient descent, Newton, Nelder–Mead, differential evolution, particle swarm, constrained optimization (SUMT) root finding — built Armadillo linear algebra library. OptimLib headers (header-mode) shipped inst/include/, R packages can use adding DESCRIPTION linking BLAS/LAPACK src/Makevars (required Windows): standalone C++ file: R, demonstration wrappers available, including callback-based minimization plain R functions: See IMPLEMENTATION.md design decisions development roadmap.
code: LinkingTo: RcppOptimLib, Rcpp, RcppArmadillo PKG_LIBS = $(LAPACK_LIBS) $(BLAS_LIBS) $(FLIBS) // [[Rcpp::depends(RcppOptimLib, RcppArmadillo)]] #include <RcppOptimLib.h>  double sphere_fn(const arma::vec& x, arma::vec* grad_out, void*) {     if (grad_out) *grad_out = 2.0 * x;     return arma::dot(x, x); }  // [[Rcpp::export]] arma::vec minimize_sphere(arma::vec x0) {     optim::bfgs(x0, sphere_fn, nullptr);     return x0; } rosenbrock    <- function(x) 100 * (x[2] - x[1]^2)^2 + (1 - x[1])^2 rosenbrock_gr <- function(x) c(-400 * x[1] * (x[2] - x[1]^2) - 2 * (1 - x[1]),                                 200 * (x[2] - x[1]^2)) optimlib_bfgs(rosenbrock, rosenbrock_gr, c(-1.2, 1)) #> $par [1] 1 1   $value ~0   $success TRUE  optimlib_nm(function(x) sum((x - 3)^2), c(0, 0))   # derivative-free optim_ackley_de(c(2, -2), seed = 42L)              # global, C++ objective
